    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Discover the marked template: all cells of its bounding box colored in marker color.
    pts=[(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    # Paint occurrences of the marked shape on empty cells.
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        cells=[(r+dr,c+dc) for dr,dc in shape]
        if all(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and grid[a][b] in (0,5) for a,b in cells):
          for a,b in cells:
            if grid[a][b]==0: out[a][b]=5
    return out
''')
